## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunctionpass">MachineFunctionPass</a> - This class adapts the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/functionpass">FunctionPass</a> interface to allow convenient creation of passes that operate on the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a> representation.</p>


<p>Instead of overriding runOnFunction, subclasses override runOnMachineFunction.</p>


<p>Definition at line 30 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/machinefunctionpass-h">MachineFunctionPass.h</a>.</p>
